abstention_analysis.interpretation: human-review outcomes are not simulated; top-model values are an evaluation-only counterfactual, not attributed recovery

analysis_corrections.reason: Corrected top-model abstention counterfactual and floored oracle STOP-option ERV at zero; sealed worlds, decisions, and outcomes unchanged.
analysis_corrections.scope: derived metrics and abstention analysis only

existing_workflow_view.semantics: existing Phase 2 multi-action workflows under original semantics; secondary only

false_safety_analysis.definition: rule blocks affecting the highest primary-model predicted-ERV candidate

abstention_transparency.criterion: autonomous, human-review, STOP rates and review reasons reported

fixed_retry_value.criterion: mean paired net-value difference versus fixed retry > 0

personalization_value.criterion: beat global or failure-reason policy on paired mean net value, or reduce mean oracle-ERV regret by at least one minor, with zero violations

reminder_comparison_reported.criterion: paired Reminder comparison is reported without gating success
